title: Fancy Yellow Radiant
subtitle: Ten carats of Fancy Yellow, cut radiant to hold the colour at its deepest.

stone.origin: Centre: 10.04 ct Fancy Yellow radiant-cut diamond. Two white Cadillac-cut side stones.

metal: 18K yellow gold prongs · Platinum surround, side settings & micro-pavé band
description: A Fancy Yellow radiant held in yellow gold double-claw prongs, the metal chosen to read at the same warm temperature as the stone so the colour deepens rather than cools. Two white Cadillac-cut diamonds flank the centre, their clean geometry and cool light framing the yellow and pushing its saturation forward. A micro-pavé band carries the line around the finger. The radiant cut was made for exactly this — taking a strong colour and concentrating it — and everything here is arranged to let it. Handcrafted in Los Angeles.
editorial: A 10.04-carat Fancy Yellow radiant in yellow gold double-claw prongs, flanked by two white Cadillac-cut diamonds and a micro-pavé diamond band. The Cadillac cut — trapezoidal, step-faceted, architectural — leads the eye from the shoulder of the shank up into the centre stone. The radiant holds its colour across sixty-plus facets. The Cadillacs hold their line.
